name: motion-shuffle-to-grid
title: Shuffle to Grid
description: Các ô đang nằm lộn xộn, xoay lệch và nhỏ đi, lần lượt bay về đúng lưới thẳng hàng.

moworks.author: moworks

options.backAt: s after the start to scatter again (null)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 3×3 tiles (34 px, 10 px gap) start scattered: each offset by a seeded uniform random up to ±24 px in x and y (recipe ±26), rotated up to ±18°, scale 0.72 (seed 23); they settle into the grid (0°, scale 1) in 720 ms back.inOut, each 35 ms after the previous in reading order (≈1 s in all). Reverse to scatter: all at once in 400 ms power2.inOut. Params: scatter: độ lệch (24 px) · rot (18°) · scale đầu (0.72) · stagger (35 ms) · seed.
